name: Neighbor Offset and Key Delta Calculation
definition: Generates 3D offset vectors for 6, 18, or 26-connectivity and converts them into packed key deltas. These deltas allow finding neighbor keys by simple addition to the current key.
summary: Neighbor Offset and Key Delta Calculation generates constant additive deltas to find neighboring voxel keys via integer addition, scaling with voxel count rather than bounding box volume.
